notes.title: Early Access Update 1 is live!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29290441/387e160627f6dbec2197db0f5ae7fbb05c77add6.png

Early Access Update 1 brings a brand new shooting range to Claybreaker - A grouse moor!

Test your shooting skills against challenging simulated driven grouse targets, flying low and straight towards you!

Changelog:

New Content:


    Driven grouse moor shooting range.


Changes:


    Weapons can now be picked up directly by pointing the move/select pointer at them with the controllers.
 Increased sensitivity of touch pad control for unlocking shotgun barrel. 


Fixes:


    Fixed bug where player could warp out of bounds when changing scene.
